verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge, and a forge with built-in AI features could plausibly consume external MCP servers, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only server-side MCP: GitCafe hosts its own MCP server and exposes its tools via WebMCP to browser agents. It also hands issues off to external coding agents. Nothing shows GitCafe itself connecting to or using third-party MCP servers' tools, so the verdict is none.
